WF-03, step 1 — ISSUE-FIXER diagnoses ISS-0116 (read the defect file docs/issues/ISS-0116-team-page-spec-low-gaps.md first, and decisions/0113 О32, О34, О35, О36). (1) Look in docs/issues/ for closed defects with the same signs (a check read before the thing it checks can happen; a window or a scroll that hides what it should prove; a text pattern that a layout defeats) and say whether the same cause came back. (2) Reproduce each of the four gaps yourself on a fresh clone of the tag base/ISS-0116-20261117-01 outside the project, with the probes named in the defect (M01p for L1, M11b for L2, P13g1 for N1, D10e for I3; re-create them from the gate handoffs of run E2E107-20261116-01: step-09-release-validator.json and step-05e-test-design-validator.json): each named test stays green on its probe; write the command and the real output. (3) Find the cause of each: which function or line, which reading is missing, why the gates of the run did not catch it earlier. (4) AP-014: search the whole spec, and the other spec files tools/test/e2e/picker.e2e.js, pixel-office.e2e.js and smoke.e2e.js, for places of the same kind — an end check run before its stand stops; an 'inside the window' check that scrolls sideways; a wait 'until the next X' with no asserted length; a plain-words or stack check that a block layout can defeat; a red message that holds a temporary path — and list each with its line and a one-line reproduction or the reason it is not exposed; say which of them belong to this defect (the team-web spec) and which are new defects for ORCH to number (do not widen this run). (5) Measure on your clone each fix that the defect proposes (items 1-5 of «Как исправить»): red on its probe, green on today's page and server; for item 4 propose the exact stack-frame shape and show it gives no false red on today's page, on D10e0 and on the plain sentences of today's refusals; for item 5 say where the path comes from and what the message should hold instead. (6) Write in result the diagnosis: the cause of each gap, the files concerned, what must change (one sentence each), the mutants the regression must catch, and any new defect found.

result.summary: Diagnosis of ISS-0116 (WF-03, step 1). Tests only: confirmed. All four gaps and the note are in tools/test/e2e/team-web.e2e.js. Every measured fix is a change of that file only, green on today's page, server and kit as tagged: the whole file is 7 of 7 green with all fixes in 33473 ms, against 33697 ms for the tag. No file of tools/src and no kit file must change, and the kit already has what a fix needs (page.network, page.evaluate, page.horizontalOverflow). L1, the trap marker read before the stand stops. Reproduced: M01p is a server that starts the trap copy in its SIGTERM handler when its data folder holds a project. With it, create and failure stay green, and the effect log says 'marker present: true' once per server with a project. Cause: endChecks (lines 461-480) runs inside the body of withTeam (254-256) or untilStopped (273-288). The reading of trapStarted (line 462) and of the project folders (line 463) therefore comes before withStand or stand.stop() sends SIGTERM. Only stand reads the marker after its stop (line 601), and it has no project. Why the gates missed it: decisions/0113 О4 reads criterion 1 as an end check in every test, and design 4.4 put that check in the body. The gates' trap mutants (V16, D22) started the trap at the server start or at create, never at shutdown; the first shutdown probe was M01p at step 9. Same kind, not named in the defect: the second half of criterion 1's end check (no project of the executor claude-cli in the data folder) is also read only before the stop. A server that makes a claude-cli project folder at shutdown (M01q) stays green, both on the tag and with the defect's marker-only fix (M01qL1). What must change: after the stop, withTeam and untilStopped read both end facts of criterion 1 again, the marker and the project folders (the same folders the end check saw). Measured: red on M01p (FIXp, FIXpf) and on M01q (M01qL1q, M01qfL1q); green on today's page (FIXALL2). L2, the window check that scrolls sideways. Reproduced: M11b moves the create button 400 px to the right in windows up to 330 px, and windows stays green. Cause: INSIDE (line 1308) calls scrollIntoView with inline: 'nearest' and only then reads the rectangle, so a sideways scroll makes an off-screen button count as inside. Why the gates missed it: design 4.4, test 7, says 'inside the window after it is scrolled into view'. Mutant M11 hides the button (display: none) and never pushes it sideways, and О13 left sideways overflow unasserted. The picker spec (picker.e2e.js lines 948-971) already has the right form: the sideways position is read before the scroll, and horizontalOverflow is asserted. What must change: INSIDE fails when the check scrolled the page sideways (scrollX stays 0), or it reads the sideways position before the scroll, as picker does. Measured: red on M11b at '320x568: the create button is inside the window' (M11c); green on today's page (M11k, FIXALL, FIXALL2). N1, the window after «Не останавливать» has no asserted length. Reproduced: P13g1 refreshes B at once on the cancel and sends the stop 1000 ms later; control stays green 3 of 3. Cause: the wait at lines 898-903 ends on the first GET of B after the click, and nothing asserts how long that took. Today it is about 5 s only because the cancel lands just after B's poll (measured 4973-5021 ms in this step). With an immediate refresh the wait ends after about 3 ms, and the late stop is then dropped by the test's own navigation. Why the gates missed it: the window came at step 05d (О32) as the fix of F2, and its probes (P13t) delayed the stop without a refresh. The refresh-at-once probe P13g1 came at 05e, the last pass. FINDING ON THE PROPOSED FIX (item 3 of «Как исправить»): asserting performance.now() - cancelAt >= 3000 after the existing wait is red on P13g1 (P13g1f, 1403 ms) and green on today's page (K2w). But it is also red on the benign P13g0, the page that only refreshes at once (P13g0f, 1408 ms, window 3 ms). The defect itself calls P13g0 benign, so that form is stricter than criterion 4 (AP-159 (3)) and must not be used. A form measured without that false red: the wait ends only when at least 3000 ms have passed since the click AND the next poll of B has come. It is red on P13g1 (P13g1a, at 'B: «Не останавливать» sends no request but a GET'), red on the earlier breakage P13t (P13t1a), green on P13g0 (P13g0a), and green on today's page with no added time (K2a 13304 ms, window 5016 ms). Same kind, same spec, not named in the defect: the chat proof that an empty message is not sent (О12; snapshot lines 1088-1091, wait 1129-1133) also ends on the next GET of the chat. P19g sends the empty text 1000 ms after an immediate chat refresh, and chat stays green 2 of 2. The same floor makes it red at 'the disabled control sent nothing' (P19gf), keeps the benign P19g0 green (P19g0f), and is green on today's page (K5a, window 4937 ms from the end of the tries). I3, a stack line in its own block element is not seen. Reproduced: D10e shows each line of a result in its own block span, and the create refusal holds a stack line; failure stays green. D10e0 (the same layout, no stack) is green. Cause: BAD (lines 75-81) has one line mark, /^\s+at /mu. It is read on the folded innerText (textOf, 408-409), which has no line start after the first character, and on textContent (sourceOf, 416-419). textContent joins block elements with no line break, and in the rendered innerText CSS has dropped the frame's leading blanks, so no reading can match. Why the gates missed it: the step 05c fix (F1) read the unfolded textContent, which keeps a line start only when the server's text itself holds the line break. No mutant put a line in its own block until D10e at 05e. The stack-frame shape measured: /^[ \t]*at \S.*:\d+:\d+\)?[ \t]*$/mu, added to BAD and applied to the innerText of each refusal not folded (create-result, chat-result, the .frow-reason rows; the body innerText of failure (a) is already unfolded and gets it through BAD). Red on D10e at 'the lines of the refusal of the create: holds <shape>' (D10ef). Green on D10e0 (D10e0f), on today's failure and chat (D10k, D10kc) and in the whole file (FIXALL, FIXALL2). Offline (bin/shape.mjs, nothing imported): no hit on any of 91 plain texts. These are the 71 string literals of src/web/texts.js read as text, the team-fail.json strings, and today's 4 page readings of failure: the reason row, the create refusal, and the page bodies of 72 and 22 lines. It hits every V8 frame with a position, with or without its blanks and with a Windows path. It does not hit position-less frames such as '(<anonymous>)', which the literal mark still catches when their blanks are kept; a real stack always also holds frames with a position. The note, a temporary path in the red output of M03. Reproduced: with the trap copy made 0600, stand is red with error 'spawn <tmp>/sai-e2e-team-web-<id>/trap/claude-trap.js EACCES'. Where it comes from: runTrap (lines 299-332) spawns folders.trap, the real path under the kit's temporary folder from makeTempDir. Its 'error' handler (lines 323-326) rejects with Node's own spawn error, whose message Node builds as 'spawn <file> <code>' (frames ChildProcess._handle.onexit node:internal/child_process:285 and onErrorNT), and node:test prints that message as error. What the message should hold: the name of the check and the code only. Measured: 'the trap copy did not start: EACCES' (M03f, red, the system temporary root 0 times in the output). Same form in the same spec: every fs error from a reading of the test's own folders passes Node's message through, with the path. J01 (the server names its journal otherwise) makes finish red with "ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '<tmp>/sai-e2e-team-web-<id>/data/p-<id>/events.jsonl'" from journal() (lines 351-357). The regression (step 6) must make these mutants red on its own tests: M01p and M01q (create, and failure through untilStopped), M11b (windows), P13g1 (control), P19g (chat), D10e (failure), and M03 (a red stand whose output holds no temporary path). It must keep the benign twins P13g0, P19g0 and D10e0 green, keep P13t red, and keep today's page 7 of 7 green. Each mutant stays green today with the commands in self_check. A new defect for ORCH (not this run): the same end-before-stop kind in tools/test/e2e/pixel-office.e2e.js, reproduced (POj). Nothing was fixed. No project file changed except this handoff. ~/.sai-team was absent before and after, and the five real Pixel Office files are identical before and after.
